name: default port
gloss: the port the server listens on unless told otherwise
text:
## Running

Start the server with `serve`. It listens on port 8080 unless you pass `--port`, and it binds to localhost only.

name: request timeout
gloss: how many seconds a request may take before it is given up, by default
text:
## Timeouts

A request that has not finished after 45 seconds is cancelled and reported as failed. Set `timeout` in the configuration to change this; `0` waits forever.

name: minimum python
gloss: the oldest Python version the package supports, as a version number
text:
## Install

```
pip install quillmark
```

quillmark needs Python 3.11 or later. Older versions fail at import with a syntax error.

name: default log level
gloss: the level of messages written to the log when nothing else is configured, in lower case
text:
# What is written to the log when the environment says nothing.
LOG_LEVEL = "warning"

name: retry limit
gloss: how many times a failed upload is tried again before giving up
text:
/// How many times an upload that failed is tried again, with the wait doubling each time.
pub const MAX_RETRIES: u32 = 4;

name: cache directory
gloss: the directory where downloaded archives are kept, as the documentation writes it
text:
## Caching

Downloaded archives are kept in `~/.cache/bramble` and reused until they are older than a week. Delete that directory to start afresh.

name: license
gloss: the name of the license the project is released under, as an SPDX identifier
text:
[package]
name = "tessel"
version = "0.9.2"
edition = "2021"
license = "Apache-2.0"
description = "Tiles for terminal layouts"

name: release version
gloss: the version of the most recent release, as a version number
text:
# Changelog

## 2.4.1 (2026-03-02)

- Fixed a crash when the input file is empty.

## 2.4.0 (2026-02-11)

- Added the `--quiet` flag.

name: page size
gloss: how many items one page of results holds by default
text:
## Paging

Results come in pages of 50 items. Ask for another size with `per_page`, up to 500; the response says how many pages there are in `pages`.

name: default branch
gloss: the name of the branch that releases are made from
text:
## Branches

Releases are cut from `trunk`. Open pull requests against it; feature branches are deleted once merged.

name: worker count
gloss: how many worker processes the server is configured to start
text:
[server]
host = "0.0.0.0"
workers = 6

[storage]
path = "/var/lib/fennel"

name: token lifetime
gloss: how many minutes an access token stays valid
text:
## Tokens

An access token is valid for 15 minutes. Use the refresh token, which lasts 30 days, to get a new one without signing in again.

name: config file name
gloss: the name of the file the tool reads its settings from, in the project's root
text:
// ConfigFile is looked for in the current directory, then in each parent.
const ConfigFile = "sprocket.yaml"

name: maximum upload
gloss: the largest file that can be uploaded, in megabytes
text:
# Limits

| What | Limit |
|------|-------|
| Upload | 25 MB |
| Projects per account | 10 |
| Members per project | 40 |

name: 既定の言語
gloss: 表示に使う言語の既定値（言語コード）
text:
## 言語

画面の文言は、何も設定しなければ ja で表示する。`--lang en` を付けると英語になる。

name: snapshot interval
gloss: how many seconds pass between two snapshots of the database
text: SNAPSHOT_EVERY = 900  # seconds between snapshots; each one replaces the oldest of the kept ones

name: output formats
gloss: the formats the report can be written in, by the names the --format option takes
text:
## Reports

The report is written as `text` unless you ask for another format with `--format`: `json` for machines and `html` for a browser.

name: supported databases
gloss: the databases the tool can connect to, by the names used in a connection URL
text:
# Databases

| Name | Since | Notes |
|------|-------|-------|
| postgres | 1.0 | recommended |
| mysql | 1.2 | |
| sqlite | 1.0 | for tests |

name: subcommands
gloss: the subcommands the command line tool accepts
text:
/// The subcommands, in the order the help lists them.
pub const COMMANDS: [&str; 4] = ["init", "build", "watch", "clean"];

name: environment variables
gloss: the environment variables the tool reads
text:
# Environment

- `MARLIN_HOME`: where state is kept
- `MARLIN_TOKEN`: the token to authenticate with
- `MARLIN_DEBUG`: set to anything to log more

name: platforms
gloss: the operating systems release builds are published for
text:
jobs:
  build:
    strategy:
      matrix:
        os: [linux, macos, windows]
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04

name: event kinds
gloss: the kinds of event a webhook can be sent for
text:
## Events

A webhook is sent when a build is `queued`, when it `started`, and when it `finished`, whatever the outcome. Nothing is sent for builds that were cancelled before starting.

name: plan names
gloss: the names of the plans a customer can subscribe to
